## Session Brief

* [F1: cluster in the partonic CM frame in the hadronic integrand](F1.md) - Make per_group_sum cluster the CM momenta (and their mirror) as MadEvent does, pin it with a hermetic test that fails on the lab-frame code, and measure which gated cells move.
* [V1: reference side and per-event share of the ttx @1 excess](V1.md) - Re-measure MadEvent's @1 from independent directories and with the first-call patch, and measure H1's per-event share on @1, before any look at this side's amplitude.
* [V2: per-point integrand against MadEvent DSIG1 in the pdfwgt branch](V2.md) - Compare this side's matched per-group integrand with an instrumented MadEvent DSIG1 at fixed points (x1, x2, momenta, configuration) where the ttx @1 excess sits, and name the factor that differs.
* [V3: re-measure the clustered rows on the CM fix, and attack the ttx residual](V3.md) - Measure the CM-clustering fix's σ shift on every matched and clustered-scale row, and attribute pp_to_ttx_0j1j_mlm @1's remaining excess, checking MadEvent's iteration bias first.
* [V4: which side owns the unmatched g q > t t~ q excess](V4.md) - Settle the +0.5-0.9 % gq excess that survives the CM fix, matching off and a fixed scale, with an adaptation-free estimate and a per-point check on vibegraph-drawn points.

## Session Report

* [V1 report: reference side and per-event share of the ttx @1 excess](V1-report.md) - The +1.28 % on @1 is not the reference (20 fresh directories agree with the bank) and not H1 (+0.03 ± 0.11 pb); it is +1.6 % on g g > t t~ g and +1.0 % on g q > t t~ q, appears only under matching, and mostly disappears with pdfwgt = F. Not yet attributed to a line of code.
* [V2 report: per-point integrand against MadEvent DSIG1 in the pdfwgt branch](V2-report.md) - The integrand clusters each matched term in the lab frame, and MadEvent clusters in the partonic CM frame. The beam tie-break in cluster.f reads the sign of p_z, so about 16 % of g g > t t~ g points cluster their gluon onto the other beam. Clustering in the CM makes 26 000 points agree with an instrumented DSIG1 on every factor (worst 3e-7), and lowers gg by 1.05 % and gq by 0.09 %. A residual of about +0.6 % on gg and +0.9 % on gq remains. It is not in the per-point integrand.
* [V3 report: the clustered rows on the CM fix, and the ttx @1 residual](V3-report.md) - The CM fix moves ttx @1 by −4.465 ± 0.083 pb (paired, 10 seeds), @0 by 0.000 and pp_to_ll_0j2j_mlm by nothing measurable. @1 is left +0.45 % (3.8σ) above MadEvent's equal-weight recombination, and +0.61 % above its reported σ. Recombination removes about a quarter of the residual, all of it on gg. The rest is gg +0.36 % (2.3σ) and gq +0.87 % (4.2σ). The gq part appears without matching and at a fixed scale (+0.53 %), and does not move with budget on either side, so it is neither clustering nor scales.
